description: This file defines the RetrieveResourcesResponse class, a Java class representing the response to a RetrieveResources command within a policies query context. It manages JSON serialization/deserialization, provides factory methods for creating instances, and encapsulates policy-related data such as PolicyId, Label, and Resources.

classes.name: RetrieveResourcesResponse
classes.description: A final class representing the response to a RetrieveResources command, containing PolicyId, Label, Resources, HTTP status, and headers. It provides methods for creating instances from JSON, with JSON serialization/deserialization and utility functions for managing policy resource responses.
